application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2025.100518, p. 3, Section 2.2 (seven vehicles, 108s2p NMC pouch cells, 58 kWh net)

units_released.note: Rule: one file per vehicle. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2025.100518, p. 3, Section 2.2 (seven vehicles, 108s2p NMC pouch cells, 58 kWh net); 7 vehicles x 216 cells

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: The parquets hold 15 named UDS signals with rows; no individual cell-voltage channel, and the computed cell_voltage_max/min (value_id 1293/1294) have no rows.

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2025.100518, p. 3, Section 2.2 (seven vehicles, 108s2p NMC pouch cells, 58 kWh net); 7 vehicles x 58 kWh net

span_unit_years.note: The 812 rows dated 2087-03-07 in CUP1, observed in the data and not described by the authors, are excluded.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://github.com/tumftm/electric-vehicle-uds-dataset; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
